en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Yaqoub Bin Yazeed, 
(It has been narrated) raising it to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The one who recites the Quran in the Parchment would have pleasure in his eyes, and (Punishment) would be lightened from his parents and even if they were disbelievers’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ya’qub ibn Yazid in a marfu’ manner from abu ‘Abd Allah  (a.s.) who has said the following: “
If one reads the Holy Quran from a copy, he benefits from his eyesight, and his parents receive relief even if they are unbelievers.”
